chapter: 1977: Kansas City honor and the piano
title: Who arranges for the band now
summary: Basie names band arrangers and Sammy Nestico, and wants an album from Benny Carter.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: In the band, we have a couple of guys, Dixon Eric Dickson and Bobby Slater but Sammy Nestico does most of the things now, and I'm trying to get an album out of Benny Carter. He's always sayings he's started but I don't believe him and Chico does most of them.
Why would you want an album out of Benny Carter? Why would you want him to do an album for you?
Well, Benny's, he's one of the kings. King Carter. He's just so good. beautiful.
